## `kast start` { #lifecycle-start }

## `kast stop` { #lifecycle-stop }

## `kast status` { #lifecycle-status }

Read exact-root runtime status.

## `kast clean` { #lifecycle-clean }

## `kast reindex` { #lifecycle-reindex }
